up: Retrieve all compound records from the documents with the Chembl ID CHEMBL5726094. Return each compound's internal identifier (CHEMBL ID), internal numeric key, compound name, record ID, the source database identifier (src_id), and the compound's key as used in the original source. Each distinct compound (each distinct molecule_chembl_id) should appear once. Include any associated data such as the record identifier, document ID, and the source type (src_short_name).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.record_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, a.doc_id, s.src_short_name AS source_type
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.molregno = cr.molregno AND a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN source s ON cr.src_id = s.src_id
WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726094';
